Hi Jonas / Kimberly,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call yesterday. The SOC 2 auditor asked us to provide a compact VM evidence bundle that demonstrates:
- scan cadence for the last 12 months (dates, scanners, scope)
- SLA commitments and observed remediation timelines by CVE severity
- retention policy for raw scan artifacts and how long provenance is preserved
- an integrity/hash or manifest we can hand to the auditor so they can verify artifacts

Can you please provide a single packet (or link) that contains the above items, plus a short statement confirming the retention period for raw scan outputs and whether proofs (hashes) are retained immutable for at least 12 months? If possible, we need the bundle by EOD Monday (2026-06-29) to stay on the auditor timeline.

Requested format: CSV or table for cadence + remediation log (CSV preferred), PDF for policy, and a small manifest file with SHA256 hashes for attached artifacts. If any items require escalation (ops tickets, exception windows) call them out.

Happy to jump on a quick 20m sync if that helps — interested in a short run-through of the proofpack.

Thanks,

Hi Rachel — attaching the first pass. See below for a short annotation; full packet uploaded to the Drive link.

Attachments (included in upload / attached to this message as stubs):
- scan-cadence-FT.csv (dates, scanner, scope, notes)
- cve-remediation-log-FT.csv (cve, severity, ticket, opened_at, resolved_at, owner)
- vm-retention-policy-Redwood.pdf (official policy excerpt — raw scanner outputs retained 12 months by default)
- proofpack-manifest-FT-VM.txt (filename + SHA256 hash for each artifact)

Annotation summary:
- Scan cadence: monthly authenticated network scans + weekly container image scans; quarterly external penetration scans (rolling). The CSV includes scanner tool versions and scan profiles.
- Remediation SLAs: internal SLA targets are Critical <= 7 days, High <= 30 days, Medium <= 90 days. Observed medians are included in the remediation CSV; we also flag exceptions where change windows delayed fixes.
- Retention & provenance: raw scan outputs (XML/JSON) are retained for 12 months in an immutable S3 bucket with object locks; manifests are stored in our compliance ledger and snapshots are kept for 18 months for forensic traceability. The policy PDF has section references.
- Integrity: proofpack-manifest-FT-VM.txt contains SHA256 hashes; we can re-run a hash verification script and provide an auditor-facing verification command.

If the auditor wants a signed timestamp (e.g., keybase/GPG or AWS KMS signature) for the manifest, we can add that — simple to produce but adds a day.

Let me know if you want the partial packet earlier; otherwise we will finalize and send the complete proofpack by Mon EOD.

Thanks,
